title: Design: Invoices tab hides Service For when no row is for someone else
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B whose only invoice is billed to customer A, and no invoice billed to customer B.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-10-after-orchard-city-invoices.png, bt-p5-09-before-orchard-city-invoices.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's page.
  2. Click the Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer B's Invoices tab does not list the invoice billed to customer A.
  • There is no Service For column; the columns are Date, Type, No., Memo, Total, Balance, Status, Action, as in production.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-N1: “The "Service For" column is hidden when no row on the tab, before any search, is billed for someone else.”
  • S10-N2: “The customer's own Invoices tab does not list invoices billed to someone else, so they cannot be paid from its side.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "5 Getting paid", pictures "Orchard City, Invoices" (This build), "Orchard City, Invoices" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
